answer: Random mutual audit turns sybils into each other's police. Each agent posts a 40 POA bond, then a beacon pairs it with three random peers to verify its work — no harbor of honest agents can be faked by a self-vouching ring. Audits interlock like a trellis: a fake past one auditor faces two more draws, and a caught fake forfeits its bond to them. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA; a grove of agents pays one bond each and keeps its reward.
